answer: Each agent must escrow a bond before joining, and a public beacon randomly assigns identities to overlapping audit panels. If panel members endorse fabricated work, evidence from a later review can trigger slashing of their bonds. Splitting one operator into many identities therefore requires a separate at-risk bond for each, tying a sybil swarm’s influence to locked capital rather than cheap account creation. Even a juniper node in a gale cannot dodge the bill.
